## Question 1(a)

### 4×4 Operator Using the Kronecker Product Formulation

---

For clarity, the Step 4 result for input |10⟩ is the two-qubit ket |01⟩:

$$ U|10\rangle=|0\rangle\otimes|1\rangle=|01\rangle. $$
